listing.name: ScribbleFarer
listing.summary: Adds a cartoony, kid-like aesthetic with playful ship designs, exaggerated weapon effects, and whimsical visuals.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a cartoony, kid-like aesthetic with playful ship designs, exaggerated weapon effects, and whimsical visuals.

description: So, I was thinking, Why not make a cartoony version of starfarer? Were guns go Pew pew and ships go Boom? Why not make it all kid like, as though it was all from the back of a 12 year old's notebook? Well, Why not? So here we go :D
descriptionHtml: So, I was thinking, Why not make a cartoony version of starfarer? Were guns go Pew pew and ships go Boom? Why not make it all kid like, as though it was all from the back of a 12 year old's notebook? Well, Why not? So here we go :D
aiDescription: Adds a cartoony, kid-like aesthetic to Starfarer with playful ship designs, exaggerated weapon effects, and whimsical visuals. Features a new Vandalian faction, custom missions, and a unique art style inspired by notebook sketches. Includes a variety of new ships and weapons with humorous, stylized mechanics.
